title: First release of Diktatura
items: The Leader and decrees: every 5 minutes he adds, repeals or swaps laws — 31 laws in total
Punishments: workday fines, confiscation, arrest — a ride in a prisoner-pulled cart, forced labour and a cell
The capital mountain near spawn: a prison inside, the throne hall, state offices and a casino on top
Workdays and jobs: courier, cleaner, miner, lumberjack, royal builder
Licenses and the hidden law book section "Licensed activities": logging, ore, swimming, going to the Nether
State casino: roulette, slots and dice with openly rigged odds
Loyalty and fear: paranoia with a phantom tax inspector, rebellions via underground leaflets, Blood Moon
State agencies: tax man, state post, StateTV ads, state radio, cows and anvils falling from the sky
Absurdity: thieving geese, runaway ore, mimic chests, screaming food, captcha, trees falling on you
Strange mushrooms and 8 trips: upside-down world, vertical video, potato graphics, lag
Final fight: a twice-as-big Guard Dragon, then the Leader himself and a "dictatorial draw"
Custom Blockbench models: NPCs, the cart, the Leader's weapons, the dragon; a new logo
Interface: panels, banners, decree headlines, law book (L), hide panels (H), settings via Mod Menu
